contracts.molecular_reaction: PC2G-grown BBS Hox2-only triple-mutant soluble fraction: NADH-supported H2 evolution 0.053 +/- 0.011 ul H2/h/mg total protein (Table5), with exogenous FMN/DTT, pH7,37C,6h,triplicate headspace GC.
contracts.limitations: Gene-associated preparation-level source potential only. The assayed material contains soluble total protein and added FMN/DTT; direct NADH transfer by a purified Hox2 complex, exclusive NADH/NADPH enzyme specificity and completeness of all mediating components are not established. NADPH gave no detected H2 in this preparation/direction/condition; this is not a query NADPH-negative claim. H2-linked NAD+/NADP+ reduction was not detected with limited assay sensitivity, so no reverse-direction or negative uptake contract is inferred. Complete native source members match the genome, but query activity, expression, mature boundaries, physical assembly and in-vivo direction are not measured.

contracts.molecular_reaction: H2-dependent coupled reduction of NAD+ and C. pasteurianum two-electron ferredoxin by the purified gene-associated HydABC preparation, approximately 1:1 NAD+/Fd reduction.
contracts.limitations: Gene-associated native purified-preparation reference potential only; a minor Aad contaminant was present. The assay used C. pasteurianum ferredoxin, not an identified exclusive query Fd partner. NADP+ was not reduced and NADPH could not substitute for NADH under the reported conditions; these are assay-scoped boundaries, not universal substrate exclusions. No query activity, expression, physical assembly, cofactor occupancy, kinetics, ion coupling or in-vivo net direction is established. HydA2 and putative HydS are separate proteins and are not members of this registered HydABC set.
